evidence.reason: The merged-PR validation only checks state, PR number, base, head OID, and ancestry. A merge commit can remain an ancestor of the target while its resolved tree omits or reverts the repair, so the code can set remediation_state='fixed' and record merged_fix without establishing that the repair is actually contained in the merge result. That is a false-positive remediation path in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
